correctness.rationale: Exact Chern-class expansion gives c3=-3H^3, Euler characteristic -24, and b3=28. The eight isolated holomorphic fixed points each have local real index +1. Lefschetz gives trace -4 on H3, hence eigenspace dimensions 12 and 16. Hodge symmetry gives 6 and 8 on H^{2,1}; the induced involution yields an isogeny decomposition of the intermediate Jacobian.
